186667.overview: Las Vegas is a simulation of a three reel slot machine. To increase the chances of winning, it is possible to hold certain reels (skill stop) or to nudge them for a certain number of times when it is allowed; the player may also gamble on an existing win. The goal of the game is to win jackpots.

186668.overview: Legionnaire is a run 'n gun game based on the arcade game Commando where your mission is to get to Garrison Headquarters over seven different landscapes to deliver vital messages. The game is viewed from a 3rd person perspective at an elevated angle with the screen scrolling upwards when you move. As you progress up the screen various soldiers will appear and you must avoid or shoot them with your gun because if you touch one or are shot then you lose one of five lives. To hinder you there are various obstacles that need avoiding like walls, trees and water.

186669.overview: You are mankinds only hope as huge Motherships and their fighters from the Anconian Fleet are poised to attack and you must destroy them all. In this top view horizontal scrolling shooter you must fly your spacecraft over the surface of each Mothership, blasting the enemy fighters before attempting to destroy their reactor. As you fly you must avoid or blast the fighters, gun placements, and avoid any obstacles and if you touch any or are shot then you lose one of five lives. At the end of your run over the Mothership is the reactor and you must destroy the force fields before destroying a huge ship protecting the reactor. once destroyed you move on to the next Mothership.

186724.overview: With 20 coins in your hand, you approach the electronic poker machine confidently, with the aim of making a killing. There are several winning hands, with a Royal Flush paying out at 250-1, a Royal Flush at 50-1 and Four of a Kind at 20-1. Smaller winnings can be scored with multiple pairs or pairs of 'face cards'. There are five skill levels, and four different values of money to play with. After the initial draw you can choose which cards to hold in the hope of getting the best possible combination together. There is no opponent to play, and thus no bluffing involved.

214410.overview: Lawn Tennis allows you to have a game of tennis against the computer or another player over five sets. The game is viewed from behind your player at an elevated angle. The normal of rules of tennis apply and the winner is the player who wins the best of five sets.

446199.overview:
Lone Survivor / Wacky Painter is a double games pack that contains two games released for this compilation only:

Lone Survivor: A text adventure where you are the only survivor of a nuclear holocaust and your aim is to try to survive on a day to day existence. The screen has text describing your current location and you type in commands with the keyboard to interact with your surroundings.

Wacky Painter: A single screen game where you control a brush and you have to paint all the squares in a 5 x 4 grid over various levels. To paint a square you must paint all four lines of each square to fill it and while you paint you must avoid creatures moving around the maze. If you touch a creature then you lose a life. Before the start of the game, you can select one of the first three levels and how many lives (1-4).

446317.overview: You are Special Agent Louis Mooney aka Leapin' Louie and you have been captured by the Grong Empire and you plan to escape. In this single screen platform game, you must move through ten rooms avoiding the robot guards and traps to get to freedom. To escape from a room you have to reach a teleporter but this requires six batteries to operate and the batteries are scattered around each screen. The batteries must be collected and the teleporter reached before a power gauge empties. As well as robot guards to avoid there are platforms that disappear when walked on and objects that cannot be touched. If you hit a robot or object, or your power runs out then you lose one of three lives.

446319.overview:
An old-fashioned football management game, in which you take over one of 64 clubs and try to lead them to glory. The choice is fairly arbitrary, as you can rename the team, you always start in the lowest of the four divisions, and the kits aren't real-life.

You start with only 11 players, and the maximum is 15, so you'll be keen to sign new players, and you get this opportunity after each match, when a player is offered, with his skill and form displayed. You can train your players to improve these skills, and sell players you don't rate highly.

Matches are played out via a succession of short animations, in which the home side wears red and the away side blue. At full time you are told how many injuries were incurred. The league season features 15 matches, one against each team, with the top two teams gaining promotion.

446325.overview: Locomotion is a flick screen game where you take control of a locomotive from the Wild West days to collect trucks of gold to deliver to the bank. The game has two modes - Adventure and Arcade; both have four difficulty levels. In Adventure you are able to speed up or slow down the locomotive along the tracks and also control the points of the track ahead to change to new tracks. As you explore the area you will encounter trucks and these contain various items as well as gold and these include livestock, fuel and a sheriff. To hook up to a truck, you must reverse at 20mph or less and you automatically pick the truck up. You can also unhook any trucks when you stop.

446327.overview: The 5:15 to Victoria is in trouble when the guard rushes through the carriages screaming that the train is out of control down a steep incline with the Driver not responding on the intercom. You are "Loco" Lionel, leading Hollywood stuntman who has taken the task of climbing on to the roof and attempting to get to the driver. There are 14 carriages, each on a single screen, and you must get from the right of the screen to the left avoiding all obstacles by jumping or ducking before a timer reaches zero. If you touch an obstacle or fall through the gap between carriages, then you lose one of six lives.

446343.overview: Leaper is based on the game Jumping Jack where you have to get to the top of the screen by jumping through the moving gaps in each level of platforms. In this version the idea is to reach the top of the screen six times, and with each completion, a letter from the word Leaper lights up. You have an energy bar and this decreases if you touch the sides of the screen, don't jump up through a gap cleanly, fall down a gap cleanly or fall down a couple of levels. Once the energy bar is empty then you lose one of five lives. There are also various creatures moving along various platforms and if these are touched then you lose a life.

446412.overview: Lazer 900 is a side view single screen shooter where you control a spacecraft at the bottom of the screen, moving it left or right blasting various waves of aliens above. The waves of aliens move in various formations and drop bombs to destroy you and if you are hit by one then you lose one of three lives. After completing four waves you repeat them again but much harder.

446414.overview: Space Shuttle Columbia has taken off and entered Earth's orbit to deliver six Uranium fuel packs to the rocket Argon but the orbit of Argon is too high. Your mission, in this side view single screen game is to leave Columbia in your space suit and fly upwards to deliver the Uranium one by one. Starting at the bottom of the screen you collect a pack of Uranium and fly upwards to the top of the screen avoiding asteroids, debris and satellites. Once you reach the top of the screen, you place the Uranium in one of six bays before flying downwards to pick up another pack of Uranium. You keep repeating the process being careful not to place a pack into a bay already with a pack of Uranium. Once the delivery is made you then move to another screen to repeat the same delivery but harder. If you touch any object or place the Uranium in a full bay then you lose one of three lives and start all over again.
